title: Senior Architect, Junior Architect, Civil Site Supervisor, Interior Site Supervisor
company: Sixth Sense Architects and Interior Design Studio
description:
Sixth Sense Architects and Interior Design Studio — We're Hiring!

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu **Compensation:** As per performance / experience (negotiable at interview)

1. Senior Architect

**Experience:** 3–4 years minimum relevant experience **Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (on-site) **Employment Type:** Full-time

**About the Role** Sixth Sense Architects and Interior Design Studio is looking for a Senior Architect to lead design development, coordinate with clients and consultants, and oversee projects from concept through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead architectural design development from concept to working drawings
* Coordinate with clients, consultants (structural, MEP), and site teams
* Review and approve drawings prepared by junior architects and design staff
* Ensure design intent is carried through to site execution
* Manage project timelines and design deliverables
* Guide and mentor junior architects in the team

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Architecture (B.Arch/M.Arch)
* 3–4 years of relevant post-qualification experience
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, and rendering software (Revit/Lumion preferred)
* Sound knowledge of building codes, local approval processes, and construction detailing
* Excellent communication and client-handling skills
* Council of Architecture (COA) registration preferred

**How to Apply** Send your resume and portfolio to: arch6sense@gmail.com **|**acc.mags24@gmail.com

2. Junior Architect

**Experience:** 3–4 years minimum relevant experience **Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (on-site) **Employment Type:** Full-time

**About the Role** We're looking for a Junior Architect to support design development, prepare drawings, and assist in project coordination under the guidance of senior team members.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, and sections
* Assist in design development and 3D visualization
* Support site coordination and documentation
* Prepare presentation material for client meetings
* Assist in preparing drawings for statutory approvals

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture (B.Arch)
* 3–4 years of relevant experience in an architecture/design firm
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp; working knowledge of Revit and rendering tools is a plus
* Good understanding of construction drawings and detailing
* Ability to work well in a team environment

**How to Apply** Send your resume and portfolio to: arch6sense@gmail.com **|**acc.mags24@gmail.com

3. Interior Site Supervisor

**Experience:** 2–3 years minimum relevant experience **Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (on-site) **Employment Type:** Full-time

**About the Role** We are seeking an Interior Site Supervisor to oversee day-to-day execution of interior fit-out works at project sites, ensuring quality, timelines, and coordination with contractors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Supervise on-site interior fit-out execution (carpentry, false ceiling, flooring, painting, fixtures)
* Coordinate with contractors, vendors, and labour teams on site
* Ensure work is executed as per approved drawings and specifications
* Monitor material usage, quality control, and workmanship
* Track project schedules and report progress to design/project team
* Resolve on-site execution issues in coordination with the design office

**Requirements**

* Diploma/ITI in Interior Design, Civil, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 2–3 years of relevant site supervision experience in interior fit-out projects
* Good understanding of interior materials, finishes, and execution methods
* Ability to read and interpret working drawings
* Strong on-ground coordination and communication skills

**How to Apply** Send your resume to: arch6sense@gmail.com **|** acc.mags24@gmail.com

4. Civil Site Supervisor

**Experience:** 2–3 years minimum relevant experience **Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (on-site) **Employment Type:** Full-time

**About the Role** We are looking for a Civil Site Supervisor to manage and monitor civil construction activities on-site, ensuring quality control, safety, and adherence to project schedules.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Supervise day-to-day civil construction activities (foundation, structure, masonry, plastering, finishing)
* Ensure work is executed as per structural/architectural drawings and specifications
* Coordinate with contractors, labour teams, and material suppliers
* Monitor quality of workmanship and materials used on site
* Maintain site records, daily progress reports, and material consumption logs
* Ensure safety practices are followed on site

**Requirements**

* Diploma/Degree in Civil Engineering (or equivalent practical experience)
* 2–3 years of relevant site supervision experience in civil construction
* Good understanding of civil construction methods, materials, and quality standards
* Ability to read structural and architectural drawings
* Strong coordination and reporting skills

**How to Apply** Send your resume to: arch6sense@gmail.com **|** acc.mags24@gmail.com

*Interested and qualified candidates may share their updated resume/portfolio to either of the email IDs above, mentioning the position applied for in the subject line.*

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance

Work Location: In person

title: Solution Architect: AD
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Job Type Permanant (Full Time)
* Work Experience 14- 18 years
* City Coimbatore
* Country India

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

“Digital to and from core” is the DNA of Colruyt Group. We have been pioneering in adapting IT technologies from the advent of the IT revolution. Digital Transformation is core element to realize Colruyt Group Strategic Plan. Colruyt Group has invested significantly in setting up IT architecture and is considered to be one of the best in the European region. As an Enterprise Application Architect, you will be a key member of our architecture team, enable Colruyt Group to architect and realize mission critical applications. You will be collaborating with multiple stake holders involving Business, Project Managers, and Software Engineers. You will have an opportunity to work with culturally diversified group of individuals. You will be contributing to defining and embedding Service Operating Model, Making Agreements with Business, and establishing long term relationship with stake holders. We are looking for an individual with Passion, Innovation, Out of the box thinking to join our team.

Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for making elaborate solution (application) architectures, designing complex mission critical applications.
  
2. Understand strategic objectives, Colruyt Group IT reference architecture, IT Ecosystem and propose relevant feasible IT solutions.
  
3. Communicate architecture to business, project managers, solution analysts, software engineers
  
4. Ensure application architecture is proposed and approved by Technology Review Board
  
5. Collaborate with Program/Project Managers to advise estimations, identify dependencies and create an implementable work package, project plan.
  
6. Do architecture impact analysis, technology assessments and propose solutions to ensure quality deliverables.
  
7. Define, implement and guard application architecture blueprint
  
8. Advise business to make right technology choices
  
9. Propose cost effective solutions without comprising functional and non-functional requirements.
  
10. Developing secured application, packaged solutions on cloud

  
  

### **Requirements**

* 12+ years’ experience in the IT industry and 3+ years in Enterprise Application Architecture space
* Excellent knowledge of IT systems and infrastructure.
* Experience in defining, steering and governing IT roadmaps in line with reference architecture.
* Experience in assessing architectural choices and propose fit for purpose solutions. E.g Cost benefit analysis, SWOT Analysis
* Excellent Analytical, conceptual thinking, out of box thinking skills
* Experience in breaking down complex problems and propose simplified solutions.
* Experience in architecting secured solutions, understanding and managing vulnerabilities- OAuth, ISAM, Open ID
* A strong strategic and business mindset, outstanding communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to balance the long-term (“big picture”) and short-term implications of architectural decisions
* Ability to navigate complex IT and business organizational structure to accomplish goals and gain buy-in
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, presenting briefings to senior management, business stakeholders.
* Experience in architecting J2EE applications is advantage.
* Certification, Experience in TOGAF or any relevant architecture methodology is plus
* Knowledge of Archimate, Mega is a plus
* Good understanding of Cloud technologies is an advantage
* Working with European organizations, especially in retail space is an advantage
* Should be open for onsite travel (Belgium)

  

Our Proposition:

* A challenging role in Enterprise Architecture to show case your capability
* Help realize Colruyt Group digital vision and enrich your personal experience in technology space and personal development.
* Autonomy, Personal Leadership work life balance are our core group ethos.
* Colruyt Group believes “Organization grows to the extent people grows”. We invest to enhance craftsmanship of co-workers. This will help you to work on latest and cutting edge technologies
